limitations: Different sampled populations in each snapshot. No individual linking across months.
Questions refer to the previous four weeks and name the pandemic as the stated reason.
Weighted survey estimates omit full design sampling intervals. Item bounds describe missing responses only.
Within-group occupational and industrial contrasts do not identify infection risk or an intervention effect.
